_comment: Non-copyrighted preservation manifest and bounded findings for the three-row Phase-4 seed lifecycle batch; frame boundaries are not exact writer evidence.
bounded_conclusions: Both relevant capsules reconstruct under the exact pinned reader without a record-count or domain-hash error.
The actor pool base is 0x8009FD80; the mobile A09 seed occupies slot 20 while the moving blue seed occupies slot 1 at fixture-specific address 0x8009FE04.
A09 retains three exact attachment intervals and successful post-press releases followed by horizontal stored-velocity component reversals and stable positions.
The blue fixture retains four cursor-advancing plant creations, four large seed raises, four large seed descents and four later plant retirements.
Plant slot byte +0x2E is subtype-owned raw lifecycle state: observed retirement values are 5, 5, 13 and 5, so value 5 is not a universal uproot signature.
Frame-boundary correlation does not attribute an exact CPU writer, collision geometry, plant eligibility gate, DMA/GPU/SPU producer or causal control.

A09_seed_pickup_drop.bounded_observation: The pinned pristine movie contains three exact player/seed attachment intervals. Each interval detaches after a later square press, then reaches a stable position after at least one stored horizontal velocity component reverses. The capsule does not identify the collision primitive or geometry.
A09_seed_pickup_drop.carry_attachment_predicate: seed x/z equal player x/z and player_y - seed_y equals 19200

A14_plant_seed.bounded_observation: Four typed plant-slot creations coincide with the final boundary of four large positive seed-y episodes and advance the plant cursor by one. Each follows a cross press; frame boundaries do not identify the gate or writer.

A15_uproot_plant.bounded_observation: Four typed retirements follow four large negative seed-y episodes and prior square presses. Three type-7 retirements retain raw slot byte +0x2E value 5, but the type-6 retirement retains 13; value 5 is therefore not a universal player-uproot signature. Exact teardown writers remain unresolved.

A09_seed_pickup_drop: Eligibility predicate, exact attachment/release writers, release impulse source, collision geometry/rebound law, atop-seed interaction, and reset breadth. (NOTE holding_seed fixture is ALLMODS-media, oracle-ineligible.)
Preserve the three frame-boundary release/reversal episodes; only escalate live after declaring the exact missing writer or collision-resolution experiment and matched control.
